system.name: Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAEs)
system.one_liner: Sparse autoencoders with a temporal contrastive loss so that high-level features stay consistent over adjacent tokens and separate semantics from syntax.

content.variant_note: a lettered analogy panel, a contrast panel and a measured-example panel tied together by dashed zoom lines
content.argues: Existing SAE features flicker token by token and mostly capture syntax, while temporal SAEs give smooth features that follow the semantic content of each passage.
content.subject: Human language features, what two SAE types recover, and real activation traces of both over a spliced three-passage text.

lessons.what_to_learn: Put a tiny thumbnail of the measured result inside the conceptual panel and tie it with dashed leader lines to the full plots, so the schematic claim and its evidence share one figure; open with an everyday analogy panel for the intuition.
lessons.suits: Motivation figures for methods whose benefit is a qualitative behaviour, such as smoothness or less noise, best shown by a real output plot beside a conceptual contrast.

evidence: While existing SAEs mostly recover syntactic information, T-SAEs balance recovery of semantics, syntax, and context.
Human language production involves high-level features such as semantic content and surrounding context
T-SAEs (bottom) smoothly detect the semantic shifts in the passage

summary: Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAEs) add a temporal contrastive loss so that SAE features track meaning that changes slowly over tokens. The figure has three lettered panels. A) A person emoji with thought clouds splits language production into high-level features (intent, context, audience) and low-level ones (syntax, word choice). B) A network glyph feeds two SAE types: existing SAEs yield syntactic features only, T-SAEs yield context, syntax and semantics; a dashed box holds two mini traces, noisy versus temporally consistent. C) Dashed leader lines open into two real stacked activation plots over a spliced Latin, genetics and scripture text, with coloured legends of auto-generated feature labels.
summary_zh: T-SAE 用时间对比损失让特征随语义缓慢变化。图分三块：A 用人物和思维云区分高层与低层语言特征；B 对比现有 SAE 只抓句法与 T-SAE 兼顾语义；C 用虚线引线放大到拼接文本上的两组真实激活曲线，并配特征含义图例。
notes: Pre-screen kinds kept. Panel C's two charts are one placed bitmap; the two thumbnails in panel B are separate small bitmaps. The person emoji is listed as a text glyph in the digest, taken here as a bitmap. The network glyph is read as the language model from the layout; the caption does not name it.
